company.name: Omnistrate
company.shortDescription: Automate Customer Deployments Across Any Environment
company.description: Omnistrate is a control-plane-as-a-service that transforms the user's docker image into a multi-cloud SaaS service. With the help of Omnistrate, businesses and service providers in the world can give the professionals who actually create, deploy, and oversee the life cycle of the applications access to the power of application automation.

productsAndServices.description: A cloud-native platform that enables rapid building, deployment, and scaling of multi-tenant SaaS products across multiple clouds and on-premises environments.
productsAndServices.name: Omnistrate Control Plane as a Service

productsAndServices.description: Automation tools for managing SaaS infrastructure, deployments, scaling, monitoring, and security across multi-cloud and on-premises environments.
productsAndServices.name: SaaS Operations Automation

productsAndServices.description: Tenant-aware, usage-based billing and subscription management system integrated with cloud marketplaces and payment processing.
productsAndServices.name: SaaS Billing and Subscription Management

productsAndServices.description: Support for deploying SaaS applications across any cloud provider, on-premises, air-gapped, and sovereign cloud environments with flexible tenancy models.
productsAndServices.name: Multi-Cloud and On-Premises Deployment Support

productsAndServices.description: Tools and APIs for onboarding applications, configuring services, and managing SaaS products with integration to CI/CD and GitOps workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Developer Tooling and APIs

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $4,441,000, or 85.35% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,778,302 to $25,181,487, a 3.72x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
